Eligibility Requirements:
• 501(c)(3) status (or global equivalent)

• Active for at least 1 fiscal year with tax history

• Strict alignment with foundational core missions

Application Materials:

• Initial 3-page online Letter of Intent (LOI)

• LOI limited to 1,500 words

• Full formal application by email invitation only
